result.stdout:
ratchet - the two-level roadmap runner.

Usage:
  ratchet [--rollout <key>] [--roadmap <path>] [options]
  ratchet init --roadmap <path> [--harness <name>] [options]   examine the repo + roadmap in one agent session and author/extend the manifest (Plans/rollouts.json)
  ratchet codex-stop-hook   the Codex Stop-hook entrypoint: run the rollout's injected gate for an armed step and answer on stdout. Registered by the tool in .codex/hooks.json on a Codex rollout; not meant to be typed
  ratchet doctor [--rollout <key>] [options]   diagnose the rollout's last recorded halt in one agent session over the structured logs (.ratchet/<rollout>.*.jsonl); proposes a remedy, never applies one
  ratchet import [<rollout>] [--dry-run] [--stop-entry <reference> --finished-at <instant>] [options]   import the repository's .ratchet/ metering and state logs into Reap for every bound rollout (or the one named) as the same tasks, entries and expenses a live run lands; --dry-run reports what it would write and reads Reap only
  ratchet reap [<rollout>] [--dry-run] [options]   prepare a rollout for Reap: read the Reap settings in its manifest entry and create in Reap whatever is missing (client, project, task types, the recording person's assignment); --dry-run reports what it would create and reads Reap only

Options:
  --manifest <path>               manifest file (default: Plans/rollouts.json)
  --rollout <key>                 rollout entry (default: the sole entry, if unambiguous)
  --roadmap <path>                roadmap file the run drives (optional: the rollout's manifest 'roadmap' key supplies it; this flag overrides it for one run)
  --repo-root <path>              repository root (default: .)
  --dry-run                       print the resolved plan and exit; no claude, no git (a Reap-bound rollout is read, never written)
  --report                        build the metering report from the persisted store and exit; no claude, no git
  --bill                          build the per-client billing report under the manifest comme
[truncated]
